title: Rule-augmented candidate original-language dictionary
research_boundary: The primary score is prediction of an untouched held-out family from the remaining families. Correct historical rules must beat both the original Man-grid baseline and a same-complexity shuffled-rule control. Historical/proto spelling evidence is family-compressed and never used as the held-out target after transformation.
